answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 43177 Country: United Kingdom Title: Custody of Child Question: If a woman separates from her husband for a valid reason what custody rights does she have on her daughter who has reached maturity? Answer ID: 43177 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 141/104/D=1434) After the girl turns adult her custody goes to her father hence the father has the right to keep her with him, but he does not have the right to stop her to go to meet her mother occasionally. The mother also has right to meet her at times. After her marriage, the girl shall be free to visit her mother and father with the permission of her husband. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
